notes.title: Streaming Mode
notes.content:
Hello, this is Studio AWE.

 As it turns out, more people wanted to stream than we had expected. So, we've decided to come up with "Streaming Mode" as a way to allow you to stream, just with a couple of restrictions.

 Therefore, [h3]if you are planning to live stream or record any videos with the purpose of uploading them, you must turn "Streaming Mode" ON beforehand.[/h3]

 [h3]Streaming Mode can be toggled at the bottom of the "Options" screen accessible from the title screen.[/h3]

 Please note that you cannot change modes between "Streaming Mode" and normal mode during the course of the game, so please be careful.

 The features of the "Streaming Mode" are as follows.

[list]
[*] The "Streaming Mode" indicator text has been added in the lower-left corner of the dialogue window.
[*] You can view all of the main episodes.
[*] You cannot, however, view side episodes with the exception of "Shin Hyo Jin", "Truth".
[*] You also cannot view any of the "After Stories" and "Another Story".
[/list]
 It would be greatly appreciated if streamers and viewers were to abide and respect this new streaming policy. I would also like to take this chance to thank all the streamers who have tolerated our embargo period.

 Thank you.

tags.feature: The "Streaming Mode" indicator text has been added in the lower-left corner of the dialogue window.

 Thank you always.

notes.title: Demo ver. 1.21: patch notes
notes.content:
Hello, this is Studio AWE.

 The following are some patch notes for the demo in anticipation for the Steam Game Festival.

[list]
[*] A notification system and features related to the collectibles have been made available.
[*] Mouse cursor related functions have been tweaked.
[list]
 [*] The function where the mouse cursor was automatically centered on the screen at the start of the search stage has been removed.
 [*] The function where the mouse cursor disappeared during the game has been deleted.
[/list][/list]
[list]
[*] Some effects have been adjusted.
[list]
 [*] Skipping the effects at the end of each search stage or chapter is now prevented.
[/list][/list]
[list]
[*] Some Korean lines were modified.
[*] Some English translation were modified.
[*] Japanese translations have also been added.
[/list]
 It is worth noting that some antivirus programs may misdiagnose and identify the game as a virus. This is most likely to be a result of binaries for execution in the case of 32-bit operating systems. The game has been tested and confirmed to not contain any viruses, so please do not worry.

 As always, I convey my sincerest thanks.

tags.feature: A notification system and features related to the collectibles have been made available.

tags.bug: The function where the mouse cursor was automatically centered on the screen at the start of the search stage has been removed.
The function where the mouse cursor disappeared during the game has been deleted.
Skipping the effects at the end of each search stage or chapter is now prevented.

tags.feature: Japanese translations have also been added.
